GantrySystematizing a highly-technical space that naturally feels ready to unlock potential

Project

Gantry wants to create a world where technology adapts to people, unlocking every individual’s potential. In more technical terms, Gantry helps machine learning engineers use the data that is flowing through their live machine learning-powered products to figure out how the application is really performing, find ways to improve it, and operationalize those improvements.

Our collaboration with Gantry began with an in depth analysis of their competitive space. We uncovered competitor and industry norms leading us to intentionally avoid expected AI and ML conventions in a saturated field.

Focus

AI / Machine Learning

Services

2023

When

This past year, Gantry emerged from stealth. When they received $28+ million in seed and series A funding, they knew it was time for a visual overhaul, bringing their identity into a more mature and modern space.

Our collaboration with Gantry began with an in depth analysis of their competitive space. We uncovered competitor and industry norms leading us to intentionally avoid expected AI and ML conventions in a saturated field.

The evolution of the visual system began by rethinking Gantry’s core elements while maintaining their north star of “unlocking potential”. A new expressive color palette that acts as an anchor for the Gantry visual hook was developed as a driving narrative force. In coordination with an expressive palette, precise and contemporary typography from Dinamo serve as the verbal counterpart to our visual system.

To round out the experience, a new illustration and motion language serves as a natural instrument of the imagination balancing Gantry’s technical offering.
